description.p: A Morse code trainer built around the Koch method: characters are sent at full speed from the first lesson, and new ones are added as you master the old.

ul.li: A guided Journey, character and word drills, head copy, typed copy and QRQ speed practice
Listen and Learn, short stories and a code exam
Pileup Runner, contest practice and Rapid Fire
Six arcade games played in Morse
Sending practice, drills and a sending analyzer with a USB Morse key such as the Vail Adapter, or the keyboard
A live CW decoder and the Vail repeater

description.p: The same trainer as the iPhone, iPad, Mac and Android apps. Scores made on the desktop are kept as personal bests and are not ranked on the shared leaderboard.
First desktop release for Windows and Linux.
